title: Fix PR audit for synchronized archive lineage and derived knowledge projections
outOfScope: Changing archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, manifest, or Start Receipt evidence.
Weakening append-only archive, one-Work-Item-per-PR, or fail-closed ownership policy.
Changing release workflow behavior, release tags, public Releases, or production behavior.
Allowing arbitrary unowned knowledge projection files to pass the PR audit.

sources.reason: The current PR audit rejects a valid archive whose base transition is recorded in synchronizationHistory and requires direct Summary ownership for transitive generated knowledge updates.
The lifecycle validator defines synchronizationHistory as the canonical evidence for active Work Item baseline synchronization.
Existing PR audit regression fixtures cover resume lineage and provide the bounded test surface for synchronization and projection ownership.
Release WI PR #912 exposes the two concrete fail-closed audit errors that this corrective WI must resolve.

riskAssessment.reason: The change alters PR evidence classification; it must preserve fail-closed behavior while accepting only validated lifecycle lineage and evidence-derived projection dependencies.

reasons: The change is governance and test code with no production behavior or external operation.

executionDecision.reason: The PR failure is reproducible locally and the repository already defines canonical synchronization and knowledge evidence structures for a bounded corrective implementation.

preReviewWarnings: Review that transitive knowledge ownership is limited to generated records whose evidence dependency closure reaches a currently owned changed projection.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record the implementation boundary before editing and rerun all PR-audit checks before finish.

acceptance: archive_base_is_compatible accepts an archived Contract whose Start Receipt base differs from the Contract base when synchronizationHistory is structurally valid, continuous, and ends at the Contract base; malformed or discontinuous history remains rejected.

The PR audit accepts a generated knowledge projection changed by a current owned projection dependency only when the dependency closure is evidence-derived and the current knowledge index remains valid.
The PR audit continues to reject arbitrary knowledge paths that are absent from the current Summary and have no owned generated dependency.
Regression tests cover both valid and invalid synchronization lineage and both accepted and rejected knowledge projection ownership cases.
No archived evidence is rewritten, and append-only archive, fail-closed, and one-new-Work-Item PR policies remain unchanged.
All required AI checks, focused tests, and the repository quality gate pass.
guidelines: Use the repository's canonical synchronizationHistory schema rather than introducing a second lifecycle representation.
Keep generated knowledge ownership evidence-derived and bounded to a dependency closure; do not use a broad .ai/knowledge exemption.
Add regression tests before changing the PR audit behavior and preserve rejection tests for malformed or unowned evidence.

intent.problem: The release closure PR is blocked by two PR-audit classification defects. The audit recognizes resumeHistory but not the synchronizationHistory that the canonical synchronization command writes, and it treats a transitive generated knowledge record as unowned when a directly owned knowledge projection changes its evidence digest.
constraints: Accept only the canonical synchronizationHistory structure validated by ai_start_receipt.
Preserve fail-closed rejection for malformed lineage and arbitrary unowned generated files.
Do not change release publication or production behavior.
intent.rationale: The PR audit must recognize the lifecycle evidence and generated dependency model already used by the repository; otherwise valid Work Item closure is blocked or operators are pushed toward unsafe archive edits.

rawUserRequest: Continue the release lifecycle. Resolve the PR audit root causes without rewriting archived evidence, then revalidate and close the release Work Item.

declaredIntent.summary: Make PR audit ownership and base compatibility correctly follow canonical lifecycle and generated knowledge evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A continuous synchronizationHistory ending at the Contract base is accepted on the exact or descendant PR merge-base.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Unit test archive_base_is_compatible with valid and discontinuous transitions.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A knowledge record whose generated evidence depends on a current owned projection is accepted only after the knowledge index validates.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise the PR ownership helper with an owned dependency closure and run the knowledge index checker.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Malformed synchronization history and arbitrary knowledge paths remain rejected.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Retain negative regression tests and run the complete PR aggregate suite.

restrictedWriteApproval.approvedBy: user continuation authorization in current thread
restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user authorized continuation after the PR audit root causes were identified; this WI is limited to the repository governance checker and its regression tests.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore the PR audit tests and generated governance evidence.
